articles.title: AI Powered PlayStation Crack Could Let You Play GTA 6 on PC at Launch
articles.description: AnyPS5 is working to get any PS5 game running natively on PC—and gamers are hoping it'll work for the next instalment of Grand Theft Auto.

articles.title: Ledger Finds LTE Implant That Stole Recovery Phrases in Suspected $86M Drain
articles.description: Ledger says the hidden chip reads the 24-word phrase off the screen during setup, leaving the Secure Element and its software untouched.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Gets Spooked as ‘Uptober’ Lets Down
articles.description: Crypto majors are red, alts are down bad and onchain is facing capitulation. This was not the ‘Uptober’ that was promised…

articles.title: UK Moves Closer to Keeping $5B Bitcoin Haul After High Court Ruling
articles.description: A judge ruled that Chinese law should govern fraud victims' claims to the 61,000 BTC seized from Zhimin Qian, in a blow to the claimants.

articles.title: ‘Leave’: Crypto Backlash Over French Proposal to Report Wallets Over $112K
articles.description: The proposal would require crypto owners to report holdings over €100,000, sparking concerns following a wave of "wrench attacks" in France.

articles.title: NFT Marketplace Blur to Shut Down Website, Stop New Blend Loans Next Month
articles.description: The shutdown comes as NFT trading volumes have collapsed from their 2021-2022 peak, with market revenue projected at $318 million this year.

articles.title: AI Will Hit 40% of Jobs, IMF Warns. Young People Are First in Line
articles.description: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva says AI investment is holding global growth near 3%, with Asian chipmakers winning big, while warning of a 'slow-moving tsunami' for young workers.

articles.title: Standard Chartered Will Hold Ripple's Stablecoin in Dubai—And Let Clients Trade With It Without Moving It
articles.description: The bank's Dubai branch now offers custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and plans a link with LMAX that lets institutions post it as trading collateral while the coins stay put.

articles.title: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
articles.description: Meta's new flagship beats GPT-6 Astra and Claude on memory, legal and marathon coding tests, but independent rankings still put Anthropic's Opus 5.5 on top.

articles.title: From GTA V on iPhone to Free Photoshop: This AI Tool Is Upending Software
articles.description: REA, a free toolkit that hands AI agents the keys to reverse engineering, crossed 100,000 GitHub stars in a week as AI-decompiled game mods, console ports, and Adobe clones flood the internet.

articles.title: Solana Treasury Firm DeFi Development Keeps Buying SOL as CHAD Preferred Stock Hits Record
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed company now holds about 2.59 million SOL, but its weekly purchases keep shrinking.

articles.title: Ripple-Backed Evernorth Hits Nasdaq Holding 473 Million XRP Worth Far Less Than It Paid
articles.description: Evernorth's XRPN shares began trading Monday after its SPAC merger closed, but 80% of SPAC investors cashed out first and its XRP stash is worth roughly 40% less than at signing.

articles.title: Bitcoin Spooked? Crypto Fear and Greed Index Drops to Pre-Rally August Lows
articles.description: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index has dropped to 56 from an August peak of 82, as oil, bond yields, and ETF outflows hit Bitcoin in October.

articles.title: Ledger Says All Confirmed Cases in Suspected $87M Drain Tied to Reseller CryptoBilis
articles.description: The wallet manufacturer said its own systems and direct sales are unaffected, and that the reseller has stopped selling hardware wallets.

articles.title: NEXTPredict Paid $12,000 to Hedge Its Conference on a Prediction Market
articles.description: Where event insurance deals with scrapped shows and what happens inside the venue, NEXTPredict is focusing on flight cancellations.

articles.title: XRP Ledger’s Payment Engine Had a Counterfeiting Bug Hiding Since 2015
articles.description: An integer overflow in the payment engine, dormant since 2015, could have let an attacker mint spendable XRP beyond the token’s total supply.

articles.title: Bitmine Adds $32M in Ethereum as Tom Lee Says Firm Is Nearly 'Done Stacking'
articles.description: The Ethereum treasury firm now holds 6.03 million ETH, 4.9% of supply, as Lee predicts the biggest crypto bull market yet.

articles.title: Strategy Scoops Up $21.5M in Bitcoin, Buys Back $192M in STRC
articles.description: The purchase lifts Strategy's holdings to 848,250 BTC and follows a $176 million repurchase of STRC preferred stock the week before.

articles.title: Bitcoin Ranges Near $83K as Traders Look to US Inflation Data
articles.description: October rate-hike odds have slumped, but analysts say Treasury yields at two-decade highs are still keeping a lid on risk appetite.

articles.title: UK Freezes $12M London Penthouse of Alleged Prince Group Finance Chief
articles.description: Thet Li is accused of running the finances of a scam empire tied to $14 billion in Bitcoin the U.S. has moved to seize.

articles.title: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
articles.description: An IMF analysis found that more than half of tokenized stock trading happens outside U.S. market hours, though the roughly $2.3 billion market remains more volatile and less liquid than traditional equities.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana ETFs All in the Red for October
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs have seen $386.3 million in net outflows through the first seven trading days of October, while Ethereum funds have now posted nine straight days of losses.

articles.title: How Zcash Plans to Hide Your Keys From AI and Quantum Attacks
articles.description: Zakura, a Zcash full node developer, says it expects hash-based signatures to land in Zcash in January, and is rolling out a privacy tool for rotating transparent addresses this week.

articles.title: CFTC Draws the Line Between Prediction Markets and Gambling in New Rules
articles.description: A proposed rule would expressly fold event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather into the “swap” definition, while an interim rule excludes casino-style gambling—sharpening the agency’s claim to exclusive jurisdiction.

articles.title: This Sam Altman-Backed Life Insurer Runs Entirely on Bitcoin, and Just Raised $37.5 Million
articles.description: The Bermuda-based insurer, which runs entirely on Bitcoin, drew the funding from existing backers led by Bain Capital Crypto after a record year driven by demand from wealthy families in Asia, Europe and the Middle East.

articles.title: Here’s a Way to Predict When AI Chatbots Will Turn Bad
articles.description: Physicists at George Washington University say a formula can estimate when an AI chatbot will flip from good answers to bad ones, and early tests on small models back it up.

articles.title: French Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget
articles.description: A National Assembly committee adopted amendments taxing stablecoin swaps and crypto exits by wealthy holders, then rejected the 2027 budget's revenue section.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Quietly Rehearsing for the Day After an AI Catastrophe
articles.description: Executives are war-gaming the political fallout of a major AI-driven cyberattack and preparing to brief Congress fast if and when necessary.

articles.title: Senate Democrat Presses Cantor Fitzgerald on Tether Ties and Lutnick Family Profits
articles.description: Sen. Richard Blumenthal wants Cantor Fitzgerald to open its records on Tether and on how much Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's family has earned from its business deal.

articles.title: Blockchain.com Seeks Approval for US Prediction Markets and Crypto Derivatives
articles.description: The crypto platform filed for designated contract market and futures commission merchant licenses, which would let it run its own regulated event-contract venue instead of relying on overseas partners.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rebounds After Rough Week, But Traders Are Pricing In More Downside
articles.description: Bitcoin bounced after dipping to around $80,000. Traders are placing increasingly high odds BTC slips further before October is over.

articles.title: Ethereum L2 Starknet Jumps 20% After Saying It Wants to Become an L1
articles.description: Starknet is "actively considering" becoming its own blockchain, a move it says would make it the first fully quantum-resistant network by 2027.

articles.title: DWF Labs Subsidiaries Sue BitGo for $141 Million Over Early Token Sales
articles.description: The DWF Labs-linked firms allege in London’s High Court that BitGo sold discounted Falcon Finance and ESPORTS tokens roughly two months before their lock-up expired, cratering the value of their remaining holdings.

articles.title: New York AG Secures Up to $35M and Industry Ban From Ex-Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky
articles.description: Mashinsky owes New York $25 million if he fails to forfeit another $10 million, and $10 million more if he doesn't serve his full sentence.

articles.title: Ledger Probes Potential Theft of $87M in User Funds Tied to Crypto Wallet Reseller
articles.description: Ledger asked reseller CryptoBilis to pause sales and urged recent buyers not to set up their devices, as an onchain investigator tracked more than $86 million in suspected thefts.
